moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-tategaki-reveal, written here): vertical-rl: chars top → bottom, columns right → left, column gap 1.5 em (demo ≤ 30 px fitting 126 px columns); punctuation to the upper right, long-vowel marks rotated 90°, Latin sideways. From 0.35 s each char drops y −20 px → 0 with opacity 0 → 1, 0.5 s expo.out, stagger 50 ms (recipe 40–60, ≤ 1.4 s total); chars still moving tinted accent. Exit 2.95–3.25 s power2.in. Loop 3.4 s. Recipe: text-combine-upright for 2-digit numbers. Params: độ rơi (20 px) · thời gian (0.5 s) · cách nhau (50 ms) · khoảng cột (1.5 em). Columns run right to left, top to bottom; for Vietnamese each syllable is one unit (Japanese uses writing-mode: vertical-rl).
